io.mcs.taskmanager.ui
The JavaFX front: DesktopApp, which starts Spring and opens the window; the window's controller, a Spring bean, with the task list, its filters and counts, and the search; the rows of the list; and the dialogs that open over it to add, edit and delete a task.
